summary: Frontend-only regression test of the Certame+Cargo required fix in /app/frontend/public/inscricao.html. Confirmed the REQUIRED array now includes 'certame' and 'cargoSel'. All 4 scenarios PASSED: (T1) With every other required field filled + both document uploads attached but Certame/Cargo empty, btn-inscrever remains disabled and #missing-hint shows exactly ['Certame','Cargo']. (T2) After selecting edital 02 (certame='02') and Cargo '101 - AUXILIAR DE SERVIÇOS DE EDUCAÇÃO', btn becomes enabled and #missing-hint hides (display:none). (T3) Reverting Certame to empty ('SELECIONE ALGUM CONCURSO...') correctly re-disables the button and restores 'Certame','Cargo' in the missing hint. (T4) Regression: with Certame+Cargo selected but doc uploads cleared, btn stays disabled and missing lists exactly ['Documento (frente)','Documento (verso)'].
critical_code_review_comments: inscricao.html continues to grow (~1467 lines) with inline scripts; consider extracting validation logic to a JS module.

window.__isFormValid is still defined/overridden in two places (~885 and ~1082). The fix worked in both paths because REQUIRED is referenced only in the primary definition, but the monkey-patching pattern remains fragile.
